nodes.name: Evolution API Webhook
nodes.notes: Configure this URL in Evolution API as the webhook for MESSAGES_UPSERT events on your instance. IMPORTANT: 'Webhook Base64' must be OFF in Evolution (Events -> Webhook). With it ON, Evolution embeds the whole file as base64 in this payload, and anything over ~12MB is rejected here by N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX (16MB default) before a single node runs.

nodes.name: Filter: Media Only
nodes.notes: Only forward messages that contain a downloadable file. Text/reaction/status events are dropped.

nodes.name: Filter: Groups Only
nodes.notes: Only process messages from group chats (remoteJid ends with @g.us). Individual DMs are ignored.

nodes.name: Extract Media Metadata
nodes.notes: Pulls groupId / sender / messageId / fileName / mimeType / size / mediaUrl out of the Evolution payload. Throws with a clear message if mediaUrl is absent, which is the signal that S3_ENABLED is off or MinIO is unreachable.

nodes.name: POST to CRM Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends ~1KB of metadata. The CRM stats the object in MinIO to confirm it exists and to read its true size, then inserts the inbox_files row. The x-webhook-secret header comes from the 'HFS CRM Webhook Secret' Header Auth credential — create it in n8n (Credentials -> Header Auth, name: x-webhook-secret, value: the WEBHOOK_SECRET). This n8n is community edition, where $env is NOT readable inside nodes, so the secret cannot be an expression.

parameters.errorMessage: CRM webhook returned an error — check execution log

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: The CRM webhook is idempotent (dedup by messageId), so a retry is safe. It now returns real 4xx/5xx responses instead of always 200, so failures surface as failed executions here rather than vanishing into the backend log.

notes: Evolution API setup (Mini PC) — BOTH are required:
1. S3_ENABLED=true with S3_ENDPOINT/S3_PORT/S3_BUCKET/S3_ACCESS_KEY/S3_SECRET_KEY pointed at MinIO over localhost. Evolution then writes received media straight to the bucket and reports a mediaUrl.
2. Events -> Webhook -> 'Webhook Base64' switched OFF. With it ON the whole file arrives base64-encoded in this webhook's payload and n8n rejects anything over ~12MB with a 413 before any node runs.
In n8n: create a Header Auth credential named 'HFS CRM Webhook Secret' (name: x-webhook-secret, value: WEBHOOK_SECRET).
Recommended on the n8n container: N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE=filesystem.
The bytes never pass through n8n or the CRM backend — only the MinIO object reference does. That is what lifts the old ~12MB ceiling to the full MAX_INBOX_FILE_MB (200MB).
Evolution API delivers ALL group messages from ALL monitored groups — the CRM resolves the right engagement by groupId
Files from groups not linked to any engagement are stored in unmatched_inbox for manual review
